Th ick clawed paws soundlessly step onto the exposed bark of a large Wealdwoods tree. A shifting blur of color and light ripples across 
the root, its form hard to perceive by most denizens of the woods. Hunting in the gloom of dusk, the waning sun plays tricks with 
shadows and light, enhancing the shaevrynn’s already stealthy feline traits. Light-reflecting iridophores within the feline’s quill-like 
fur, react automatically to the colors of the surrounding environment, while they lack any real precision, colors blend and bleed over 
the shifting fur like water, allowing the feline to stalk nearly invisibly. Th ese silent hunters are rarely seen and rarely caught, only their 
golden eyes, reflecting the light of the setting sun, betray their innate camouflage.
Class - Mammalia • Genus Derived Evolution - Felis • Niche - Generalist Carnivore 
Preyed upon by - Korrask, Skyelarx, Vinnirex • Preys on - Calitross, Lexati, Scavick, Solmundis, Troff Trout

Encountering Many claim that the shaevrynn is a myth since that 
when this feline wants to hide, it stays hidden. Many Travelers 
will even step near it while in the Wealdwoods and never know 
it. One of the most suggested, and often most foolhardy method 
to stir a shaevrynn from its hiding is to make a loud noise to 
scare and catch it as it scurries away. Th ough it may reveal it, the 
noise may attract other much more dangerous beasts.
An imperfect blend of hues blur like wet 
paint to match the surrounding foliage, subtly 
obscuring the cat from prey and predator alike
A troff trout rummages about the roots, 
diligently helping the tree by picking off algae, 
unaware of the predator poised above it
Wide, paws lend the shaevrynn a soft 
tread to prowl the Wealdwoods unheard. 
Between each digit stretches webbed skin 
to allow the feline to quickly swim through 
the flooded forests when needed
